RULING.subject: every feature derived from data/reference/tip_times.csv (tip_utc, tip_local, tip_hour_local, tip_dow_local, and any transform, indicator or interaction of them)
RULING.authority: acceptance criterion of this node: 'if the null mask is not separable from fold identity, tip-derived features are ruled INELIGIBLE for this wave and the reason is recorded'

reasons.statement: On operational fold train_lt_2022 the feature has 0 observed values in 410 of 410 training rows. The fold cannot be fitted with it at all. GATE_INVOCATION_CONTRACT section 4 permits exactly two outcomes for a fold-degenerate term -- fail that fold, or a fallback frozen and registered with a numeric trigger before any result is visible. No such preregistered fallback exists for tip coverage.

Fold identity alone explains 76.78% of the null mask's variance; the mask is 100% coincident with fold 1 and, inside fold train_lt_2022's training set, has ZERO variance. There is no within-fold contrast there that could distinguish a tip effect from a 2021 level effect.

2023, 2024 and 2025 are 99.6%, 99.6% and 100.0% covered. That is availability, not eligibility. It does not repair fold train_lt_2022, and the frozen gate's pooled PASS is uninformative because the gate cannot see a fold.

tip_times.csv is built by data/reference/collect_bios.py::phase_tips, which takes commence_utc=('commence_utc','last') from the LATEST odds snapshot per game and does not retain the snapshot timestamp. For the 36 games whose commence time provably moved (n_commence_variants > 1) the retained value cannot be shown to predate the forecast cutoff. D10_FIELD_AVAILABILITY_LEDGER already records this as CUTOFF_UNPROVEN on 2,438 of 2,438 covered rows; this node reconfirmed it by reading phase_tips.

28 of the 37 league_prior_all team-game rows -- 75.7% of the incumbent's coldest fallback tier -- fall on tip-null rows. Any imputation of the tip nulls injects a proxy for the exact stratum V2 finding S6 measures as carrying 37-42% of MSE as BIAS. Apparent feature value could be pure stratum re-centring, and the frozen gate has no dimension for that.

The six 2026 null games are 2026-07-30 (3) and 2026-07-31 (3) -- the final two days of the universe, postdating the last odds capture. The null mask is open at BOTH ends of calendar time, so a tip feature is missing precisely on the most recent games a deployed model must score.

what_this_ruling_does_NOT_say: it does not say a tip effect is absent -- no fit was run and none may be, this wave
it does not condemn the underlying odds feed; the unprovenness is a property of the DERIVATION

it does not extend to tip.scheduled_tip_time__contract_v4_screened, which D10 records as the only CUTOFF_VALID field in its ledger, on 814 of 2,982 rows (27.3%) and 0% of 2021-2024 -- that field is out of this node's scope and carries its own, worse, fold-coverage problem

reproduction_of_the_reported_pattern.what_is_true: 1,219 of 1,495 games are COVERED; 276 are NULL. 2021 is 209 of 209 NULL, i.e. 100% null, not 'none'.
reproduction_of_the_reported_pattern.the_claim_is_also_internally_incoherent: a 1,219-game mask containing no 2021 game cannot be 'almost exactly fold 1', which is 209 games
reproduction_of_the_reported_pattern.the_qualitative_conclusion_survives: the null mask IS dominated by fold 1: 209 of 276 nulls (75.72%) are 2021, and 2021 is 100% null

the_mask_is_calendar_time_not_basketball.reading: the mask is 'the game predates the odds archive, or is in the 2022 playoffs, or postdates the last capture'. It encodes data-collection history, not any property of the game.

null_mask_vs_fold_identity.honest_qualification: the mask is NOT literally identical to fold identity: 67 games (4.48%) are null outside 2021 and eta2 leaves 23.2% of the mask's variance unexplained by fold. But 59 of those 67 sit in 2022, the earliest test fold, and the fold that decides admission -- train_lt_2022 -- carries no contrast whatsoever.

frozen_feature_gate_pooled.why_it_does_not_fire: |corr(null mask, target)| = 0.0174, two orders below the 0.5 threshold, and no outcome_mask makes the mask an exact outcome indicator

contradictions.statement: V2_STOP_CONDITION records the tip null mask as '1,219 of 1,495 games and NONE of 2021'. CORRECTION_ADDENDUM C7 records the same 1,219/1,495 as COVERAGE with '2021 coverage is zero'. The bytes say 276 null / 1,219 covered and 2021 is 100% null. The stop-condition packet inverted the addendum's coverage figure into a null figure and then negated the 2021 statement.
contradictions.resolution: the addendum and the bytes agree; the stop-condition packet is wrong on both numbers. Its qualitative conclusion ('the mask is nearly fold 1') is nonetheless correct.
contradictions.action: reported, not edited -- both packets are frozen

contradictions.statement: the packet records 'market odds / totals -- source data/odds_capture/ -- coverage 2026-07-31..2026-08-06 only -- UNAVAILABLE HISTORICALLY'. tip_times.csv is a tracked artifact built by collect_bios.py::phase_tips from odds snapshots reaching back to 2022-05-21, and the packet's own CORRECTION_ADDENDUM calls it 'odds-derived'. The stated reason for the unavailability verdict is false.
contradictions.nuance_that_must_travel_with_it: the odds tables are untracked and absent from this branch, so market-odds features are in fact unavailable HERE -- but for a reproducibility reason, not the capture-window reason the packet gives

This is not specific to tip times.
